title: On the tangent degree and the degree of the tangent variety of a projective variety
summary: The tangent degree $τ(X)$ of a projective variety $X^n\subset\mathbb P^N$ is the number of tangent spaces to $X$ at smooth points passing through a general point of the tangent variety $Tan(X)\subseteq\mathbb P^N$, if positive and finite; it is equal to zero if $\dim(Tan(X)) 1$ and provide their classification in small dimension.
